li.font: i1 and i2 are duplicate keys because i1.equals(i2) returns true.
if we replace HashMap with IdentityHashMap then i1 and i2 are not duplicate keys because (i1 == i2) returns false.
In this case of IdentityHashMap the output is {10=Beta, 10=Alpha}
